standard_prerequisites.name: The relative dualizing complex, its trace map, and the smooth proper duality identification with a shift of the top differentials
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Duality for Schemes, remark duality-remark-relative-dualizing-complex (invoked at proof line 5899) and label duality-lemma-smooth-proper (invoked at proof line 5901)
standard_prerequisites.use: They provide the trace map $Rf_*\omega^\bullet_{X/S} \to \mathcal{O}_S$ and, over a Noetherian base, the isomorphism $\omega^\bullet_{X/S} \cong \Omega^n_{X/S}[n]$ from which the map $t$ is obtained.

standard_prerequisites.name: Perfectness of the relative de Rham complexes, and the relative cup product duality statement
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter derham.tex, label lemma-proper-smooth-de-Rham (invoked at proof lines 5905 and 5935) and Duality for Schemes, remark duality-remark-relative-dualizing-complex-relative-cup-product (invoked at proof line 5911)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first makes $Rf_*\Omega^p_{X/S}$ perfect, the second turns the identification $\Omega^p \otimes \Omega^{n-p} \cong \Omega^n$ into the perfection of the pairing induced by the relative cup product.

standard_prerequisites.name: Absolute Noetherian approximation and base change of the cup product
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Limits, labels limits-lemma-descend-finite-presentation, limits-lemma-descend-smooth, limits-lemma-descend-dimension-d, limits-lemma-descend-surjective and limits-lemma-eventually-proper (invoked at proof lines 5925-5928) and Cohomology, label cohomology-lemma-base-change-cup-product (invoked at proof line 5937)
standard_prerequisites.use: They spread the situation out to a Noetherian base with a proper smooth equidimensional model, and identify the cup products of the original situation as pullbacks, so that the trace map descends to the general case.

standard_prerequisites.name: The bottom part degeneration, giving a perfect complex of tor amplitude starting in degree one
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter derham.tex, label lemma-relative-bottom-part-degenerates (invoked at proof line 5953)
standard_prerequisites.use: It makes $P$ in the distinguished triangle $f_*\mathcal{O}_X \to Rf_*\mathcal{O}_X \to P \to f_*\mathcal{O}_X[1]$ perfect of tor amplitude in $[1, \infty)$ and the triangle locally split, which is what produces the decomposition used for uniqueness.

core_obligations: Over a Noetherian base: take the relative dualizing complex with its trace map, use smooth proper duality to identify it with $\Omega^n_{X/S}[n]$, obtain $t$, and conclude that the pairing is perfect because the complexes are perfect and the multiplication exhibits $\Omega^p \cong \mathcal{H}om(\Omega^{n-p}, \Omega^n)$ (proof lines 5897-5912).

Existence in general: apply absolute Noetherian approximation to find a proper smooth equidimensional model $f_0 : X_0 \to S_0$ with $S_0$ Noetherian, choose $t_0$ for it, and pull $t_0$ back along $S \to S_0$; the identification $Rf_*\Omega^p_{X/S} = Lg^*(Rf_{0,*}\Omega^p_{X_0/S_0})$ and the compatibility of the cup product with base change transfer perfectness (proof lines 5914-5948).

Uniqueness: form the distinguished triangle $f_*\mathcal{O}_X \to Rf_*\mathcal{O}_X \to P \to f_*\mathcal{O}_X[1]$; by the bottom part degeneration $P$ is perfect of tor amplitude in $[1,\infty)$ and the triangle splits locally, giving a local decomposition of $Rf_*\Omega^n_{X/S}[n]$ as a direct sum of the dual of $f_*\mathcal{O}_X$ and the dual of $P$ (proof lines 5950-5963).

Read off that $R^nf_*\Omega^n_{X/S}$ is finite locally free with a perfect pairing against $f_*\mathcal{O}_X$; hence every $\mathcal{O}_S$-linear $t' : R^nf_*\Omega^n_{X/S} \to \mathcal{O}_S$ is $t \circ g$ for some $g \in \Gamma(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$, and $t'$ still gives a perfect pairing only when $g$ is a unit function, which is the asserted uniqueness (proof lines 5964-5975).
proof_roadmap: The Noetherian case via the relative dualizing complex (proof lines 5897-5912).
Existence in general by absolute Noetherian approximation (proof lines 5914-5948).
Uniqueness via the split triangle and the decomposition (proof lines 5950-5963).
The perfect pairing against $f_*\mathcal{O}_X$ and the unit condition (proof lines 5964-5975).
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the relative Hodge duality pairing: a trace map on the top relative differentials, unique up to a unit of the global functions, making the relative cup product pairing between complementary degrees perfect (statement lines 5876-5894). The proof identifies the map with the trace on the relative dualizing complex over a Noetherian base and transfers it to the general case by absolute Noetherian approximation and base change, while uniqueness comes from splitting the triangle comparing $f_*\mathcal{O}_X$ with $Rf_*\mathcal{O}_X$, exhibiting the top relative differentials as a direct sum of duals and reducing the freedom to multiplying by a global function, which must be a unit. The duality identification together with the splitting argument for uniqueness is the substance, so the claim is H3.
